passages.title: The School Refill Station · Original A2 Practice Text
passages.text:
Suka Jaya School opened a refill station beside the library. Students can fill a reusable bottle with drinking water before class or during the break. The station is available from seven in the morning until three in the afternoon. A small sign explains how to use the tap and reminds students to close it after filling a bottle. The tap is easy to reach.

The school chose a refill station because many students used single-use plastic bottles. These bottles were often thrown away after lunch. The new station gives students another choice. A reusable bottle can be washed and used again, so it may reduce the number of plastic bottles in the school bins. However, students must bring their own bottles because the station does not provide cups.

A student volunteer checks the area twice a day. If the floor becomes wet, the volunteer places a warning sign nearby and tells the school office. This helps prevent people from slipping. The station is cleaned every afternoon by the school staff. During the first month, the school counted 140 refills, but it did not calculate how many plastic bottles were avoided. The project team plans to review the numbers at the end of the term.

passages.title: The River Watch Team · Original B1 Practice Text
passages.text:
The River Watch Team at Harapan Senior High School collects information about a stream that passes behind the sports field. The team began after residents reported that the water sometimes looked cloudy following heavy rain. A science teacher explained that a single observation cannot show whether water quality is changing. Therefore, students agreed to record the same features at regular times and compare their notes.

Each Friday, four students visit two marked points along the stream. They observe the water colour, note any unusual smell, and measure its temperature with a simple thermometer. These readings are written on a shared form. The word “consistent” in the team's guide means that students should use the same method each week. This makes the records easier to compare, although it does not turn the school activity into a laboratory test.

The team also takes photographs from the same positions. This allows members to compare visible changes without relying only on memory. If the water looks unusually cloudy, they inform the teacher, who contacts the local environmental office when necessary. The students do not touch the water or collect samples because they have not received the equipment and training for that work.

After eight weeks, the students noticed that the stream was often clearer on dry days than after heavy rain. However, their notes do not prove what caused every change. The team plans to continue recording observations during the next term and share a short report with residents. Its main contribution is a regular record that can help the community ask better questions, not a formal scientific conclusion about the stream.

questions.prompt: What does “reusable” mean in the passage?
choices: Able to be used again
Made to be thrown away immediately
Filled only by school staff
Too large to carry
choiceExplanations: Correct: the next sentence says the bottle can be washed and used again.
The passage contrasts reusable bottles with single-use bottles, so this is the opposite meaning.
Students bring and use their own bottles; staff do not fill every bottle.
The text gives no information about bottle size.

choices: Dapat digunakan kembali
Dibuat untuk langsung dibuang
Hanya diisi oleh petugas sekolah
Terlalu besar untuk dibawa

questions.evidence: A reusable bottle can be washed and used again
questions.explanation: Petunjuk makna muncul langsung setelah istilah: botol dapat dicuci dan digunakan lagi. Gunakan kalimat penjelas itu, bukan tebakan dari bentuk kata.

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly identify the references in the passage? Select ALL.
choices: “These bottles” refers to single-use plastic bottles
“This” in “This helps prevent people from slipping” refers to placing a warning sign and telling the office when the floor is wet
“It” in “close it after filling a bottle” refers to the library
“The station” in “the station does not provide cups” refers to the refill station
choiceExplanations: Correct: the previous sentence names single-use plastic bottles, which are the referent.
Correct: the warning sign and report are the actions that help prevent slipping.
The word it refers to the tap, not the library.
Correct: “the station” refers to the refill station introduced in the first paragraph.

translationId.prompt: Pernyataan mana yang tepat mengidentifikasi acuan dalam bacaan? Pilih SEMUA.
choices: “These bottles” merujuk pada botol plastik sekali pakai
“This” pada “This helps prevent people from slipping” merujuk pada pemasangan tanda peringatan dan pemberitahuan ke kantor saat lantai basah
“It” pada “close it after filling a bottle” merujuk pada perpustakaan
“The station” pada “the station does not provide cups” merujuk pada stasiun isi ulang

questions.evidence: These bottles were often thrown away after lunch
questions.explanation: Ikuti kata yang disebut sebelumnya dan cocokkan makna. These bottles mengulang botol plastik sekali pakai; this merangkum tindakan pencegahan; it pada instruksi keran merujuk pada tap; the station mengulang refill station.

questions.prompt: Classify the function of each connector as used in the passage.

statements.text: “because” in “The school chose a refill station because many students used single-use plastic bottles”
statements.explanation: Because memperkenalkan alasan sekolah memilih stasiun isi ulang.

statements.text: “However” in “However, students must bring their own bottles”
statements.explanation: However memperlihatkan batas layanan setelah informasi tentang pilihan botol yang dapat digunakan kembali.

statements.text: “so” in “so it may reduce the number of plastic bottles”
statements.explanation: So memperkenalkan kemungkinan hasil dari penggunaan botol yang dapat dicuci dan dipakai lagi.

translationId.prompt: Kelompokkan fungsi konektor sebagaimana digunakan dalam bacaan.
statements: “because” pada kalimat “The school chose a refill station because many students used single-use plastic bottles”
“However” pada kalimat “However, students must bring their own bottles”
“so” pada kalimat “so it may reduce the number of plastic bottles”

questions.evidence: The school chose a refill station because many students used single-use plastic bottles
questions.explanation: Because memberi alasan, however menandai batas atau kontras, dan so menunjukkan hasil. Tafsirkan konektor dari hubungan kalimat lengkap.

questions.prompt: What does “nearby” mean in the sentence about the warning sign?
choices: Far from the wet floor
Close to the wet floor
Inside the library office
Under the water tap
choiceExplanations: The sign is placed to warn people about the wet area, so far away would not fit the purpose.
Correct: nearby means close to the place being discussed.
The passage does not say the sign is inside the office.
The sign is placed on the floor area, not under the tap.

translationId.prompt: Apa arti “nearby” dalam kalimat tentang tanda peringatan?
choices: Jauh dari lantai basah
Dekat dengan lantai basah
Di dalam kantor perpustakaan
Di bawah keran air

questions.evidence: the volunteer places a warning sign nearby
questions.explanation: Fungsi tanda peringatan membantu memahami nearby: tanda harus diletakkan dekat area basah agar orang melihatnya.

questions.prompt: Which statements about connector meanings are correct? Select ALL.
choices: “because” introduces the reason for choosing the station
“However” introduces a limitation about bringing bottles
“If” introduces the condition under which the volunteer acts
“During” signals a contrast between two opinions
choiceExplanations: Correct: because introduces the reason students used single-use bottles.
Correct: however introduces the limit that students must bring their own bottles.
Correct: if introduces the condition that the floor becomes wet.
During marks a time period, not a contrast between opinions.

translationId.prompt: Pernyataan mana tentang makna konektor yang benar? Pilih SEMUA.
choices: “because” memperkenalkan alasan memilih stasiun
“However” memperkenalkan batas bahwa siswa harus membawa botol sendiri
“If” memperkenalkan kondisi ketika relawan bertindak
“During” menandai kontras antara dua pendapat

questions.evidence: If the floor becomes wet, the volunteer places a warning sign nearby
questions.explanation: Periksa hubungan yang diperkenalkan setiap konektor. Because = alasan, however = kontras/batas, if = syarat, sedangkan during = waktu.

questions.prompt: Classify each reference by what it points to.

statements.text: “it” in “close it after filling a bottle”
statements.explanation: It merujuk pada keran atau tap yang harus ditutup setelah digunakan.

statements.text: “This” in “This helps prevent people from slipping”
statements.explanation: This merangkum tindakan menaruh tanda peringatan dan memberi tahu kantor sekolah.

statements.text: “the volunteer” in the paragraph about checking the area
statements.explanation: Volunteer menunjuk orang yang menjalankan tugas relawan; kategori ini mengelompokkan rujukan manusia, bukan benda atau tindakan.

translationId.prompt: Kelompokkan setiap rujukan berdasarkan hal yang ditunjuk.
statements: “it” pada “close it after filling a bottle”
“This” pada “This helps prevent people from slipping”
“the volunteer” pada paragraf tentang pemeriksaan area

questions.evidence: This helps prevent people from slipping
questions.explanation: It menunjuk keran, this menunjuk tindakan pencegahan, dan volunteer menunjuk orang. Periksa apakah kata merujuk pada benda, tindakan, atau manusia.

questions.prompt: What does “consistent” mean in the team’s guide?
choices: Using a different method every week
Recording only unusual events
Using the same method each week
Working without a written form
choiceExplanations: The passage says students should not change the method every week.
The team records regular observations, not only unusual events.
Correct: the guide defines consistent as using the same method each week.
The students use a shared form to record readings.

choices: Menggunakan metode berbeda setiap minggu
Hanya mencatat peristiwa tidak biasa
Menggunakan metode yang sama setiap minggu
Bekerja tanpa formulir tertulis

questions.evidence: students should use the same method each week
questions.explanation: Bacaan memberikan definisi langsung setelah kata consistent. Maknanya ialah memakai metode yang sama agar catatan dapat dibandingkan.

questions.prompt: Which reference matches are correct? Select ALL.
choices: “These readings” refers to the observations and measurements recorded on the shared form
“This” in “This allows members to compare visible changes” refers to taking photographs from the same positions
“they” in “they inform the teacher” refers to the students who notice unusually cloudy water
“Its” in the final sentence refers to the local environmental office
choiceExplanations: Correct: readings refers to the recorded observations and temperature measurements.
Correct: photographs from the same positions allow visual comparison.
Correct: students are the team members who inform the teacher when they notice unusual cloudiness.
Its refers to the River Watch Team, whose contribution is described in the final paragraph.

translationId.prompt: Pasangan rujukan mana yang benar? Pilih SEMUA.
choices: “These readings” merujuk pada pengamatan dan pengukuran yang dicatat di formulir bersama
“This” pada “This allows members to compare visible changes” merujuk pada pengambilan foto dari posisi yang sama
“they” pada “they inform the teacher” merujuk pada siswa yang melihat air sangat keruh
“Its” pada kalimat terakhir merujuk pada kantor lingkungan setempat

questions.evidence: These readings are written on a shared form
questions.explanation: Rujukan harus cocok dengan makna dan urutan. These readings merangkum hasil pengamatan; this menunjuk tindakan memotret; they menunjuk anggota tim; its menunjuk tim.

questions.prompt: Classify the relationship expressed by each connector.

statements.explanation: Following menandai urutan waktu: pengamatan air keruh dilaporkan terjadi setelah hujan lebat.

statements.text: “However” in “However, their notes do not prove what caused every change.”
statements.explanation: However membatasi kesimpulan setelah pengamatan yang tampak lebih jernih pada hari kering.

statements.text: “If” in “If the water looks unusually cloudy, they inform the teacher.”
statements.explanation: If memperkenalkan syarat yang harus terjadi sebelum siswa memberi tahu guru.

translationId.prompt: Kelompokkan hubungan yang dinyatakan oleh setiap konektor.
statements: “However” dalam “However, their notes do not prove what caused every change.”
“If” dalam “If the water looks unusually cloudy, they inform the teacher.”

questions.evidence: However, their notes do not prove what caused every change
questions.explanation: After menata urutan waktu dan konteks hubungan pengamatan dengan hujan, however menandai batas kesimpulan, dan if menyatakan syarat tindakan.

questions.prompt: What does “Therefore” show in the first paragraph?
choices: An example of the stream’s colour
A contrast with the residents’ report
A condition for visiting the stream
A result or decision based on the teacher’s explanation
choiceExplanations: The stream colour is not given as an example after therefore.
The sentence does not contrast two different colours or opinions.
Therefore does not introduce a condition; if is used for that purpose.
Correct: the teacher explains the limits of one observation, so students decide to record features regularly.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh “Therefore” pada paragraf pertama?
choices: Contoh warna sungai
Kontras dengan laporan warga
Syarat untuk mengunjungi sungai
Hasil atau keputusan berdasarkan penjelasan guru

questions.evidence: Therefore, students agreed to record the same features at regular times
questions.explanation: Therefore memperkenalkan keputusan yang mengikuti penjelasan guru. Siswa memilih pengamatan berkala agar dapat membandingkan catatan.

questions.prompt: Which context clues help explain the meaning of “cloudy” in the passage? Select ALL.
choices: The water sometimes looked cloudy after heavy rain
Students record water colour and compare observations
The team has a shared form
The word is used to describe a change in how the water looks
choiceExplanations: Correct: the timing after heavy rain helps the reader picture a change in water appearance.
Correct: recording water colour is directly relevant to understanding cloudy.
The shared form explains how data are recorded, not the meaning of cloudy.
Correct: the sentence uses cloudy to describe the visible appearance of the water.

translationId.prompt: Petunjuk konteks mana yang membantu menjelaskan arti “cloudy”? Pilih SEMUA.
choices: Air kadang tampak keruh setelah hujan lebat
Siswa mencatat warna air dan membandingkan pengamatan
Tim memiliki formulir bersama
Kata tersebut digunakan untuk menggambarkan perubahan tampilan air

questions.evidence: residents reported that the water sometimes looked cloudy following heavy rain
questions.explanation: Makna cloudy didukung oleh konteks tampilan air, warna yang diamati, dan hubungannya dengan hujan. Formulir hanya menjelaskan cara pencatatan.

questions.prompt: Classify each item by its role in the passage.

statements.explanation: They menggantikan anggota River Watch Team yang melihat air sangat keruh.

statements.text: “This” in “This allows members to compare visible changes”
statements.explanation: This menunjuk tindakan mengambil foto dari posisi yang sama.
However memperlihatkan batas antara pola pengamatan dan kesimpulan sebab yang belum dapat dibuktikan.

translationId.prompt: Kelompokkan setiap unsur berdasarkan fungsinya dalam bacaan.
statements: “This” pada “This allows members to compare visible changes”

questions.evidence: However, their notes do not prove what caused every change
questions.explanation: They menunjuk anggota tim, this menunjuk tindakan memotret, dan however membatasi kesimpulan. Ketiganya membantu mengikuti kesinambungan dan hubungan antargagasan.
